protocol: Five patient-disjoint outer folds; frozen compact CNN checkpoints selected by historical inner BCE. Ordinary CNN, not historical globally selected EMA. Fixed 80-epoch fusion recipe, no outer-based tuning. Historical TEST not accessed.

fine_tuning.reason: Conditional experiment: no independent inner fusion improvement gate was established; do not unlock using outer results.

final_model_evaluation: Final head fitted1092eligible development patients. No heldout performance assigned; OOF uses different fold-local CNN weights.
conclusion: No se demuestra una ventaja de la fusión sobre las variables clínicas: el intervalo pareado de AUC incluye cero o favorece al modelo clínico.
historical_label_limit: Five unknown I-SPY1 outcomes excluded from new clinical/fusion fits and evaluation. Reused historical fold CNNs had included these noisy labels in fitting; residual label noise remains.
bootstrap_limit: Patient-stratified bootstrap conditional on these trained folds; does not include model fitting or selection variability.
